About

About Muhammad Sajwani

Muhammad Sajwani is a Keynote Speaker, seasoned C-Level HR Executive, Board Advisor, Leadership & Cultural Enabler and Transformation Leader currently serving as the Managing Director of Evolve HR Consulting.

With over three decades of local and international experience, he has established himself as a trusted advisor and a catalyst for meaningful organisational change. A prolific writer and thought leader, Muhammad has published nearly 500 articles across local and international journals, sharing insights on leadership, human behaviours, emotional intelligence creativity, and change management.

His philosophy of unlocking the 'human potential' reflects his belief in the untapped areas within individuals and teams. Recognised for his innovative approach and people-centric mindset, Muhammad designs and delivers strategic programs, management development initiatives, and conferences that empower professionals to embrace change and thrive in evolving environments.

Through his leadership journey, Muhammad continues to shape organisational cultures, nurture talent, and empower people to excel in an ever-evolving business landscape.

“Your skills define what you can do. Your thinking defines how far you go.”
